===
group=io.swcode.urbo
org.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx1g

# Reuse task outputs across builds instead of recompiling. Without this the CI cache is
# nearly worthless: restoring ~/.gradle/caches only avoids dependency downloads, and a
# measured warm CI run still executed all 1108 tasks with 0 FROM-CACHE, coming out 277s
# SLOWER than no cache at all because the 702 MB restore cost more than it saved (#6861).
# The local cache directory lives in ~/.gradle/caches/build-cache-1, which CI already
# persists, so enabling this is what makes that cache pay for itself.
org.gradle.caching=true

observation.command: grep -rn "github" backend/build.gradle.kts | head; echo ===; cat backend/gradle.properties
